context_requirements: Endothelial cells or angiogenesis-dependent co-culture; the nine lines are transformed epithelial, melanoma, hepatic, colorectal, breast, prostate and lung lines, not endothelial cells.
HPGDS or HRH1 expression and a prostaglandin/histamine autocrine loop; neither is a canonical angiogenesis driver in these lines.
A 6-24 h transcriptional readout of angiogenesis itself is not expected because tube formation and vascular remodelling are post-transcriptional and occur over days.
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent change in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines that is shared across multiple angiogenesis inhibitors and absent for non-angiogenesis drugs.
Selective induction of HIF1A, VEGFA, EDN1, NOS3, CXCR4, PROS1, SERPINE1, MMP2, TIMP2, LOXL1, COL4A1, FGFR2, PDGFA, TGFB3 or other angiogenesis-related landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h.
Line-specific responses tracking HPGDS or HRH1 expression, which would support a direct target-mediated effect rather than a generic response.
